trialMessage: Your trial ended on {{date}}. You can view your saved work. Choose a plan to create, edit or publish posts.
selectDestinations: Select destinations to see your post on each platform.
mcpTrialExpired: Your trial has ended. Saved posts, accounts and the calendar are still viewable. Creating or changing posts requires an active plan in SimplePost.
socialHero: Give your AI a publish button.
socialLead: SimplePost is an open-source social media scheduler for ChatGPT and Claude. Write, schedule, and post to 10 networks, right in your conversation.
devLead: SimplePost is an open-source social posting stack you can use today. Run the SDK, CLI, API server, scheduler, or MCP server with your own platform credentials and workflows.
allCodeGitHub: All the code is on GitHub.
devRepoLead: SDK, CLI, API server, scheduler app, MCP server, documentation, and examples are available in the public repository under the MIT license.
chooseInterface: Pick the interface that fits your workflow.
mcpQuickstart: Add the remote MCP URL to ChatGPT, Claude, or another OAuth-capable MCP client.
cliQuickstart: Run simplepost connect, then post interactively or from scripts and CI.
sdkQuickstart: Use the unified posting model directly inside a TypeScript application.
apiQuickstart: Run the self-hosted API server or call the hosted Scheduler API with an authorized credential.
